  <p>Senior AI Engineer at Wispa Digital. I build the AI agents and pipelines behind our marketing products and help the team ship them into production.</p>
</div>

## What I work on

- **Competitor research agents:** LangGraph agents that gather and summarise what competitors are doing.
- **Marketing ideation:** agents that turn a brief into campaign and content ideas.
- **SEO analysis:** LLM pipelines that audit pages and surface ranking opportunities.
- **Brand-aware content:** generation workflows that stay on brand voice and guidelines.
- **Shipping AI features:** working with the development team to get these into production apps.
